stories.title: Lead azide detonation in Iowa by U.S. Army paused indefinitely after lawsuits are filed
stories.summary: The U.S. Army's plan to detonate five tons of unstable explosives containing lead azide at a munitions plant in Iowa has been put on indefinite hold by a federal court Friday.

stories.title: Child shot with unsecured gun on Detroit's west side, police say
stories.summary: Police are investigating after a 5-year-old was shot with an unsecured gun Friday on Detroit's west side.

stories.title: Child critically hurt after being shot with unsecured gun, Detroit police say
stories.summary: Police are investigating after a 5-year-old was shot with an unsecured gun Friday on Detroit's west side.

stories.title: Two men charged in separate Oakland County human trafficking cases involving woman, minors
stories.summary: Demonte Thompson, 23, and Paul Dilisio, 59, are both facing multiple felonies after the Oakland County Sheriff's Office said an investigation into Thompson led to evidence against Dilisio.

stories.title: Michigan Gov. Gretchen Whitmer talks working with Trump, her time in office
stories.summary: "Call me in January," Whitmer said when asked what she thinks of Mr. Trump. As she reaches the end of her time in office, Whitmer talked about her time in the state's top job.

stories.title: Monroe County man held without bond for fatally assaulting teen brother
stories.summary: A Monroe County man faces open murder and other charges relating to the death of his brother and the assault of two other relatives.

stories.summary: Two men are facing multiple felonies after the Oakland County Sheriff's Office says an investigation into one of the men led to evidence against the other.

stories.title: Monroe County man held without bond for fatally assaulting teen brother
stories.summary: A Michigan man is being held without bond after he was arraigned on charges relating to the death of his 15-year-old brother and injuries to his mother and stepfather in Monroe County.

stories.title: Trump touts Asia deals and meeting with Xi and Putin
stories.summary: President Trump touted his meetings with China's Xi Jinping and Russia's Vladimir Putin at a White House press conference on Friday. CBS News' Natalie Brand reports.

stories.title: Prosecutors rely on forensic lab results in Ashley Elkins murder trial
stories.summary: Prosecutors turn to forensic lab results in the trial of DeAndre Booker, who is accused of killing Ashley Elkins. The Metro Detroit mother of two was reported missing in January 2025, and her body has never been found.
